text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Asahi Hai FS. In the stands 
sat Mejiro Ryan, wearing a grave 
expression. Her defeat in the previous 
race still seemed to linger.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"I'm not worthy of the Mejiro name..." 
While Mejiro Ryan blamed herself, Mejiro 
Bright believed whole-heartedly in her 
future success.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Asahi Hai FS is Ines Fujin's first GⅠ 
race. With the real thing just ahead, 
uncertainties like her preparation period 
linger on her mind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When Ines Fujin picked up on that anxiety, 
she ended up comforting you with 
encouraging words instead. For now, 
believe in her strength...!
